purpose: Correct earlier mistaken inference that B has extra canonical Chinese strokes because its SVG has 15 contours while A has 14. Build a source-backed semantic contour mapping and fail-closed structural gate.

interpretation.fact_1: Official 喜 has 12 strokes: 一丨一丨㇕一丶丿一丨㇕一, hence the middle dot, left-falling stroke and horizontal are canonical original strokes 7, 8 and 9.
interpretation.fact_2: Counterfactual B draws these three roles with 3 separately named art contours; no unmapped newly inserted semantic stroke is found from the registered IDs.
interpretation.fact_3: Original A artistically combines canonical 7–9 into 2 paths and splits canonical 1, 5 and 11 into multiple contour fragments, so 14 SVG nodes are NOT 14 official writing strokes.
interpretation.fact_4: Even matching all semantic source IDs does NOT prove that shape, stroke direction, placement and overall Chinese writing are correct. Human visible glyph review remains necessary.
interpretation.user_judgment: User explicitly chose A and rejected B as incorrectly written for this logo. Keep B user-invalid, but do not falsely assert that its three middle marks are extra dictionary strokes.
interpretation.correction_to_earlier_assistant: Prior inference '乙多出错误的笔画' was overconfident; user was right to demand correct Chinese writing, not a proof that B violated normative stroke count.

implementation.method: Semantic path IDs manually frozen and checked against known original glyph reference; includes two negative fixtures for an unmapped added contour and a missing lower 口 bottom stroke.
implementation.limits: Static example-specific tool, not arbitrary-character OCR nor automatic orthographic correctness certification.

verification_replay.disclaimer: This is verified source-ID consistency only; cannot identify visually malformed characters and is not a human standard-stroke assessor.

future_mandatory_workflow: Before any new glyph generation: freeze canonical source character/version, exact stroke order and component map; map each artistic contour to original legitimate stroke(s). Reject unmapped additions or missing required parts; then require a Chinese reader to approve actual visual glyph and 96px version. Only after both A and B pass glyph gate run design taste comparison; do not auto-promote model or return to endless SVG tuning.
